summary: UBL e-invoice with UTF-16 BOM fails parser, causing AP hold
description:
Issue summary: A batch of vendor e-invoices submitted as UBL XML arrived with a UTF-16 byte-order-mark (BOM). Our invoice parser fails to normalize the encoding, resulting in malformed XML parsing and routing the invoices to the AP 'manual review' queue. Impact: 14 vendor invoices (total ~€42k) stuck in AP hold for the EU region; payment run risk for upcoming weekly payout. This is blocking finance from meeting the scheduled payout for affected vendors.

Observed behavior: The parser raises an XML parse error on initial ingest and the invoice record is auto-flagged as 'needs_manual_review'. Expected behavior: Parser should detect/strip BOM, decode UTF-16, and ingest UBL fields (supplier VAT, line amounts, invoice total) without human intervention.

Attachments on ticket: sample_invoice_0326.xml (redacted), ingestion_log_2026-03-12.txt
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Upload a UBL invoice XML file encoded in UTF-16 with a BOM to the AP ingestion endpoint
2) Observe the ingestion job run in the invoice-parser service for the eu-west cluster
3) Check the invoice status in AP queue; parser logs show XML decode/parse errors and invoice is routed to manual review
4) Attempt manual re-upload after re-encoding to UTF-8 -> ingestion succeeds and invoice fields populated
logs: 2026-03-12T09:14:22Z invoice-parser[ingest-worker]: ERROR parse_xml: failed to parse XML: invalid token at offset 0
2026-03-12T09:14:22Z invoice-parser[ingest-worker]: ERROR decode: unknown encoding 'utf-16' (BOM present) - fallback failed
2026-03-12T09:14:23Z ap-queue[router]: INFO invoice INT-629876 queued for manual review (reason: parse_failure)
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: recent vendor started sending UBL using UTF-16 with BOM; parser library previously handled UTF-8/UTF-8-BOM only
Confirmed with sample file: file begins with 0xFE 0xFF BOM and XML prolog references UTF-16
Re-encoding sample to UTF-8 allows parser to ingest normally - indicates encoding detection/normalization step missing
Invoice-parser is using third-party XML library v2.1.3; changelog shows UTF-16 edge cases fixed in v2.2.0
Risk: automated patch could affect other ingestion paths; staged fix recommended with feature flag
comments: 2026-03-12 10:05 - Priya Desai: Raised by AP team during morning intake. Finance flagged 14 invoices; requesting priority triage as payments scheduled Fri.

2026-03-12 11:12 - Ethan Morales: Investigating. Pulled sample XML from S3://finance/e-invoice/inbound/2026-03-12/. Parser error indicates unexpected token at start of file. Attempted local re-encode -> successful ingest. Assigning to invoice-parser owners.
2026-03-12 14:30 - Sofia Nguyen (AP): Confirmed affected vendors: ValoriTech GmbH, Intertext SARL, Nordic Supplies OY. All invoices were sent via e-invoice channel this morning.

2026-03-13 09:00 - Ethan Morales: Created quick workaround: finance can re-encode files to UTF-8 using provided script and re-upload. Draft PR for parser patch created (see related_github_prs). Planning to deploy patch behind feature flag to staging tomorrow.
2026-03-13 16:20 - Finance Ops: Applied manual re-encode for 12/14 invoices; 2 invoices pending vendor re-send due to mismatched attachments. Scheduled payment window updated.

2026-03-13 17:45 - Ethan Morales: Next steps: complete PR review, run integration tests on staging eu-west, and coordinate feature-flagged rollout to prod during low-traffic window. Follow-up ticket to add encoding tests to CI.
resolution_notes: Workaround: Finance re-encoded inbound UTF-16 UBL files to UTF-8 and re-uploaded; 12 invoices cleared. Two invoices required vendor re-send for missing attachments. Engineering: patch prepared to upgrade XML library and add UTF-16/BOM detection and normalization, to be deployed behind feature flag after QA. Follow-up tasks: INT-630001 add CI encoding tests, INT-630002 update onboarding doc for vendors specifying accepted encodings.
notes_for_next_steps: 1) Complete PR review and merge to main with feature flag
2) Run staging eu-west ingestion tests with sample UTF-16 files
3) Coordinate with Finance Ops for a controlled rollout (low-traffic window)
4) Post-deploy: monitor ap-queue backlog and ingestion error rate for 48h
5) Update vendor onboarding docs and send a notice to vendors recommending UTF-8 or explicitly labeled UTF-16 with sample template
